title: Creature, Insect - Dragonfly, Caught in Net (Wing Movement)
author: jaegrover
changes: Real recording of a dragonfly's wings buzzing and fluttering, made as it beat its wings in a mist net at a bird-banding station. Trimmed to 9.60–11.98 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 200 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 200 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble and a 100 Hz hum in the background; the wing buzz itself sits above 1 kHz.
